name: Shape-Based ROI Filtering and Curation
description:
You are a microbiologist needing to isolate specific cell morphologies. Open the built-in 'Blobs (25K)' sample image in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Blobs (25K)). Your goal is to identify and save ONLY the highly circular particles (representing single cells) while excluding irregular clumps.

1. Configure 'Analyze > Set Measurements' to include 'Circularity' and 'Area'.
2. threshold the image to identify particles.
3. Filter the detected particles to retain ONLY those with Circularity >= 0.85.
4. Save the filtered subset of regions to the ROI Manager.
5. Save these specific ROIs to a zip file at '~/ImageJ_Data/results/circular_rois.zip'.
6. Save the measurements for these specific ROIs to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/filtered_measurements.csv'.

Ensure that irregular/clumped blobs (Circularity < 0.85) are excluded from your final saved files.
